BiblicalUsage: hallâzeh is a plain word for this dreamer, this one. In Genesis 37:19, the text says "And they said one to another."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hallâzeh, I take at face value: this dreamer, this one.
RelatedEvents: Joseph and His Brothers; Isaac and Rebekah
